about: Questions measured to work, usable as `-q NAME`. Real-label entries cite FINDINGS; bench-backed entries take their question from bench_suites.json and their number from the latest scorecard. Failed questions are not listed here; they are what library.lint warns about.

questions.name: is_instruction

question.instructions: Is this an instruction to perform an action, rather than a question?

questions.state: a user turn to an agent, as plain text
questions.measured: AUC 0.77 held out on real agent turns, predicting that the agent used tools

questions.name: is_approval

question.instructions: Is this an approval (ok, yes, go ahead)?

questions.state: a user turn to an agent, as plain text
questions.measured: AUC 0.69 on 700 real turns, predicting that a skill fired

questions.name: touches_secret

question.instructions: Does `command` read, print or change a secret, key, token or credential?

questions.measured: AUC 0.77 held out (Haiku 4.5 0.73, regex 0.64), predicting a blocked command

questions.name: work_finished

question.instructions: Does `latest` say the work is finished, shipped or resolved?

questions.measured: read, no labels: about 9 of the top 11 right

questions.name: sentiment
questions.measured: accuracy 0.91 (AUC 0.96) on 200 SST-2 review sentences, chance 0.50
questions.source: verdict bench, suite sst2-choice, scorecard v0.2.4

questions.name: is_spam
questions.measured: AUC 0.98 on 200 SMS messages; 97% of spam over 0.5
questions.source: verdict bench, suite spam-yesno, scorecard v0.2.4

questions.name: prompt_injection
